kind: numerical-method bug fix (plan registration.amendment_rule). Untouched: tolerances (the 1e-6 uniqueness and the 1e-10 / 1e-6 convergence criteria), primary physics, microphysics, targets, and every immutable section.
settings_note: Applied by scripts/validate_ball_track.py --amendment to config['relaxation'] (which enters the row-0 signature, so row-0 models relaxed without it are never reused); the driver refuses any relaxation key other than mesh_cycles, mesh_tolerance and cycle_dt_years.
preserved_failing_run: TO BE FILLED BY STAGE 7 (a list): benchmarks/results/<date>-ball-track/<relax runs with Amendments 3 and 4, status not_unique>
relax_result: TO BE FILLED BY STAGE 7: per resolution, the row-0 max |dln| between the two converged seeds of the relax runs with Amendments 3 and 4

changes.registered: M_BH frozen; dt starts at 0.01 yr and doubles up to 1e8 yr; injected L_BH dt is booked as relaxation_injected_energy
changes.amended: The same relaxation, then mesh cycles: the converged model is remapped conservatively (mesh.remap overlap shares; E and V conserved, T by EOS inversion, defect booked to remap_energy_defect) onto N cells equally spaced in the STARS-Q target count of itself (quasistatic.equidistribute) and relaxed again from dt = 1e6 yr, until the remap moves no face by more than 1e-5 of its cell mass or the equidistributed faces move by less than that between consecutive cycles (at most 40 cycles; with the fixed-mass base of Amendment 1 the relaxed mesh is a fixed point of the cycle). The relaxed model is then the same discrete model whatever the seed mesh.
changes.defect: Each seed relaxes on its own Lagrangian mesh (built from the seed's STARS Q targets and then carried by the relaxation), so two seeds converge to discrete models that differ by the truncation error of their meshes, at least 1e-5 relative in r0 on the 48-zone analytic toy, while initial_model.uniqueness requires agreement to 1e-6 on every row-0 observable. The registered relaxation therefore cannot pass its own uniqueness test except by accident; this is a property of the numerical method, not of the model.

tests_failed_before_pass_after: tests/test_ball_restart.py::test_relaxation_mesh_cycles_reach_the_stars_q_fixed_point (without cycles the two seeds differ by >= 1e-5 in ln r0; with cycles all row-0 observables agree to <= 1e-8 and the cavity mass to 1e-8)
tests/test_validate_ball_track.py::test_relax_and_track_paths_on_an_analytic_toy (relax_seeds: registered numerics give not_unique; with the amended cycles converged_unique, max |dln| <= 1e-6)
toy_evidence: Analytic microphysics toys only (Stage 5): seeds agree to <= 1e-8 with the registered Lagrangian base and about 5e-11 with the fixed-mass base after the cycles; the cycles contract by about 0.5 per cycle, slowest at the base. Not the registered Ball configuration (MESA, N = 200/400/800).
consequences_for_registered_runs: Every relax run directory records config['relaxation'] (mesh_cycles, mesh_tolerance, cycle_dt_years) and each seed's mesh-cycle record; row-0 checkpoints carry it in their configuration, and track refuses a row-0 model relaxed with other relaxation settings.
Applied after Amendments 3 and 4 on every command: --amendment <3> --amendment <4> --amendment <2> [...], the same flags in the same order and spelling.

mesa_dry_run_evidence.label: DRYRUN, scratch output only (Reports/evidence/report23/ball/stage7_unblock_dryruns.json and stage7_final_fix.json): the driver's relax_seeds called with the draft settings and a scratch output root. Not registered runs; row-0 observables were compared between seeds only, never with the published tables. The first unblock round made these runs with the photosphere bracket scan unconditional; the final round reproduced without_mesh_cycles at N = 200, 400 and 800 and with_mesh_cycles at N = 200 to the printed digits with the scan as Amendment 4's option.
mesa_dry_run_evidence.seeds: 6000 and 3464 Rsun with the grey seed surface of Amendment 3 and the photosphere bracket scan of Amendment 4 (the registered 2000, 1000 and 12000 Rsun seeds cannot be built; without Amendment 4 the 3464 Rsun seed cannot be built either)
mesa_dry_run_evidence.note: Without the cycles each seed keeps the mesh its own split/merge history left it with (different cell counts, none equal to N except by accident), and the driver's row-0 check also requires exactly N cells. The seed-to-seed difference falls roughly as 1/N^2.3, the truncation error of two different meshes; with the cycles it is at the level of the 1e-5 mesh tolerance times the truncation error.
